nodes.display_name: The reaction of a virus and soap
nodes.long_description:
1.Get water in the washroom
2.Melt soap
3. Put the virus in the soapy water
4.Roading a gun with a soap bomb and fighting the virus
5. Select an option
6.Freedom to fight the virus by loading bullets
nodes.short_description: In virtual reality, we shoot viruses at various properties with appropriate ammunition to fight viruses and find out the properties and countermeasures of viruses
